steps.js: (async () => { const g = __dmh; try { g.audio.unlock(); await g.audio.ctx.resume(); } catch (e) {} await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 2500)); const A=g.audio, sp=A.ctx.createScriptProcessor(1024,1,1); const S={pk:0,sq:0,n:0}; sp.onaudioprocess=(e)=>{const b=e.inputBuffer.getChannelData(0);for(let i=0;i<b.length;i++){const v=Math.abs(b[i]);if(v>S.pk)S.pk=v;S.sq+=b[i]*b[i];}S.n+=b.length;}; A._out.connect(sp); sp.connect(A.ctx.destination); window.__meas=async(ms)=>{S.pk=0;S.sq=0;S.n=0;let red=0;const t0=performance.now();while(performance.now()-t0<ms){red=Math.min(red,A._limit.reduction);await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,20));}return {peak:(20*Math.log10(S.pk||1e-9)).toFixed(1),rms:(10*Math.log10(S.sq/Math.max(1,S.n)||1e-12)).toFixed(1),limGR:red.toFixed(1)};}; return 'ctx ' + A.ctx.state + ' guns ' + [...A.buffers.keys()].filter(k => k.startsWith('guns/')).length; })()
